title: The Effect of Honey on Nocturnal Cough and Sleep Quality
brief_summary: Cough is a common symptom in pediatric practice. It can be particularly troubling to children and their parents.It often results in discomfort to the child and loss of sleep to both the child and the parent. The objective of this trial was to compare the effects on nocturnal cough and the sleep difficulty associated with URIs of a single nocturnal dose of three different honey products compared to placebo
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 1-5 years of age complying of nocturnal cough that was attributed to a URI.

Exclusion Criteria:

* asthma,
* pneumonia,
* laryngotracheobronchitis,
* sinusitis,
* allergic rhinitis,
* use of cough or cold medication on the night before entering the study.
